libs/flows/windows/hpx_rebranding/app_co.summary: AppConsents is a Windows UI automation page class that extends HPXRebrandingFlow. It provides comprehensive test automation methods for HP application consent and privacy screens, supporting multiple regions including China and India with region-specific consent handling. The class contains over 70 methods categorized into verification flows (for validating UI elements) and action flows (for interacting with UI elements). Key functionalities include verifying and interacting with privacy consent screens, managing data collection preferences (product improvement and advertising toggles), handling terms of use and privacy statements, supporting app-only and app-device consent flows, extracting and validating consent text content, and managing app settings and reset operations. The class uses a driver object to perform UI automation operations with configurable timeouts and includes extensive logging for debugging purposes.
